scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good day~
I'm {1}, your
guide to exploring
the Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您好~我是 {1}，您的艾音布罗克中央塔游览向导。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Einbroch Tower offers
the best view of our city
and it's a great place to
meet with friends or take
a date. The Einbroch Tower
admission fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在艾音布罗克中央塔能欣赏到全城最美的风景，是朋友聚会或约会的好去处。
门票只需 10 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, we're offering
a special promotion called
the Apple Combo Set for only
20 zeny. This set includes
Einbroch Tower admission
and an Apple to snack on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前我们推出了特惠苹果套餐，只需 20 Zeny，包含艾音布罗克中央塔门票和一个供您享用的苹果。

scripts.text: Tower Admission Only
scripts.translation: 仅购买门票

scripts.text: Apple Combo Set
scripts.translation: 苹果套餐

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny. The Einbroch
Tower Admission
fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您的 Zeny 不足。艾音布罗克中央塔的门票需要 10 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感谢您使用我们的服务。我这就带您前往中央塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny. The
Apple Combo Set is 20 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您的 Zeny 不足。苹果套餐需要 20 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before I guide you to
the tower, let me check
your status to insure
your safety before I give
you the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
带您前往中央塔之前，请让我先检查您的状态，确保安全后再为您提供苹果套餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感谢您使用我们的服务。我这就带您前往中央塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you're carrying
too many items with you. Please store some of your things in your Kafra Storage before purchasing
the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您携带的物品太多了。请先将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，再购买苹果套餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
Feel free to
come back any
time. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，欢迎随时再来。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
Greetings,
I am Morei,
Assistant Guide
of Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
您好，我是莫雷，艾音布罗克中央塔的助理向导。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
If you wish to return
to the ground floor,
please let me know.
Would you like to go
back to ground level?
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
如果您想回到一楼，请告诉我。您现在要下楼吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
Let me lead you
to the ground floor.
Thank you for using
our services.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
好的，我这就带您回到一楼。感谢您使用我们的服务。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
I hope you
enjoy your time
in Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
好的，祝您在艾音布罗克中央塔玩得尽兴。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Welcome to
the Train Station.
Trains to Einbech
are always running
so if you miss one,
it's no problem.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
欢迎来到火车站。开往艾音贝赫的火车班次很多，错过一班也没关系。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
The fare to board the
train that runs the Einbroch
to Einbech line is 200 zeny.
Would you like to buy a ticket?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
从艾音布罗克开往艾音贝赫的火车，票价为 200 Zeny。您要买票吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text: About the Environment...
scripts.translation: 关于环境...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Thank you
very much.
Have a safe trip.
^333333*Ahem*^000000 All aboard!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
非常感谢。
祝您旅途平安。
^333333*咳咳*^000000 各位请上车！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I'm sorry, but this
isn't enough zeny
to pay the train fare.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
很抱歉，您的 Zeny 不够支付火车票价。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Very well, then.
Please enjoy your
stay in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
好的。
祝您在艾音布罗克度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Einbroch is infamous for
its air pollution, no doubt
caused by the industrial
facilities located here.
It's really horrible...
scripts.translation:
[职员]
艾音布罗克的空气污染严重，早已臭名远扬。这无疑是这里的工业设施造成的。
真是糟透了...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Sometimes the air pollution
gets so bad that it becomes
hard to breathe. If you hear
the Einbroch Smog Alert, you
should find shelter immediately!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
有时空气污染严重到让人难以呼吸。如果听到艾音布罗克烟雾警报，请立即找地方避难！

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
Laaaand sakes!

[Leslie]
An old woman like me
can't breathe this air! How
do people even live in all this
smog? Sure, the air in Einbech
isn't pristine, but the air here in Einbroch is much worse! ^333333*Cough~!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[莱斯利]
我这把老骨头，可受不了这样的空气！人们怎么能在这么重的烟雾里生活？
虽然艾音贝赫的空气也不算干净，但艾音布罗克这里可差多了！^333333*咳~！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
I hate coming here
sometimes! The air is
totally polluted and this
city is full of stuck up
pricks! But they sell stuff
here I can't buy back home...
scripts.translation:
[莱斯利]
有时候我真不想来这里！空气污浊不堪，满城还都是些傲慢的混蛋！
可这里有些东西，在老家买不到...

scripts.text:
[Tan]
All the factories
here in Einbroch are
causing a serious air
pollution problem.
scripts.translation:
[谭]
艾音布罗克的这些工厂造成了严重的空气污染。

scripts.text:
[Tan]
I'm an Airship engineer and
everyday, all day long, I deal
with oil stains and all sorts
of pollutants. I'm surprised
I haven't gotten sick yet...
scripts.translation:
[谭]
我是飞空艇工程师，每天从早到晚都跟油污和各种污染物打交道。居然到现在还没生病，连我自己都觉得奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Tan]
Still, I try to be careful
when I can. Whenever I go
out into the city's red fog,
I always wear my Flu Mask.
If you'll be here for a while,
you should carry one with you.
scripts.translation:
[谭]
不过，能小心的时候，我还是尽量小心。每次出门走进城里的红色烟雾，我都会戴上口罩。
如果你要在这里待上一阵子，最好也随身带一个。

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
Excuse me...
But I'm lost!
I can't find my
mom or dad!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
打扰一下...我迷路了！找不到爸爸妈妈了！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
A-am I at the Airport?!
My parents are supposed
to come get me, but I still
haven't found them! We just
moved here, so I don't know
where anything is!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
我...我这是在飞空艇站吗？！爸爸妈妈应该会来接我，可我还没找到他们！
我们刚搬来，我哪里都不认识！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
W-wait!
Where are you
going?! Don't leave
me, I'm all alone...!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
等...等等！你要去哪里？！别丢下我，我就一个人...！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
H-hey! Don't
touch my precious
Burielle! I just finished
her tune-up and now she's
sleeping! J-just step away!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
喂...喂！别碰我的宝贝布里埃尔！我刚给她调试完，她现在正在睡觉！
快...快退后！

scripts.text: Who's Burielle?
scripts.translation: 布里埃尔是谁？

scripts.text: Sorry about That.
scripts.translation: 抱歉

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Burielle is the prettiest
model among all the Airships
made within the last ten years!
She might be grounded now, but
with my healing hands, she'll
conquer the skies again!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
布里埃尔是近十年来建造的飞空艇里，最漂亮的一款！
她现在虽然停飞了，可只要有我这双妙手，就一定能再次征服天空！

scripts.text: Ah~
scripts.translation: 啊~

scripts.text: Uh huh...
scripts.translation: 嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah~
I see, so you're
working on restoring
this magnificent specimen
of an Airship. Best of luck~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊~原来你正在修复这艘气派的飞空艇。祝你顺利~

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Yeah. I'd appreciate
it if you'd just be careful.
I've put a lot of love into
fixing up Burielle...
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
没错。你要是能小心一点，我会很感激的。
为了修好布里埃尔，我可是倾注了不少心血...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh huh...
Right. For a second
there, I thought you were
talking about a person, but
then I also assumed that you
weren't, you know, a nutcase.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯嗯...好吧。刚才我还以为你在说一个人呢，不过那时我也以为你不是个疯子来着。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, did you say,
''prettiest model?''
All Airships look the
same to me, this one
ain't special at all. You've
gone loony tunes, paley boy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你说“最漂亮的一款”？在我看来，飞空艇都长一个样，这艘也没什么特别的。
老兄，你真是疯了。

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Wh-what...?!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
什...什么...？！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Well, at least you know
what you did wrong. Now
quit disturbing her and git!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
哼，至少你知道自己错了。别再打扰她，赶紧走！

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
I've lived here for
a long time and I see
that this huge city is still
growing bigger everyday.
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
我在这里住了很多年。这座城市已经这么大了，却还在一天比一天大。

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
How did Einbroch get so
huge so quickly? I still can't
believe there's been this much
development. Well, I suppose
it's not my concern. Nothing
I do will make a difference...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
艾音布罗克怎么这么快就发展成了大城市？变化这么大，真让人难以置信。
不过，想来也不关我的事。反正我做什么都改变不了...

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
Even though such
rapid industrialization
can't be good for the
environment or the people,
I'll just sit back, watch what
happens and just enjoy life...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
工业化这么快，对环境和居民肯定没好处。不过，我还是坐在一旁看看会发生什么，过好自己的日子就行了...

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
^666666*Cough cough*^000000
Jiminy! The air here
is so thick and grimy!
And it's worse for us old
people with breathing
problems! ^333333*Haaack!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
^666666*咳咳*^000000
天哪！这里的空气又呛又脏！我们这些呼吸不好的老人就更受不了了！^333333*咳啊！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
I don't care if they keep
building more and more
factories and homes in this
town. Still, I'd like to spend
the rest of my life somewhere
quiet and with clean air...
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
他们爱在城里盖多少工厂、多少房子，我都不在乎。我只想找个安静、空气干净的地方，度过余生...

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
Then again, Einbroch is my
hometown and I can't just up
and leave. I suppose it's my
fate to suffer from this foul air until the day I die. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
可艾音布罗克毕竟是我的家乡，我也不能说走就走。看来，我命中注定要忍受这污浊的空气，直到死的那一天。^666666*唉...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
Lately, there's been
talk about this empty
building downtown that's
been converted into some
sort of mysterious facility.
scripts.translation:
[凯蒂娜]
最近，大家都在议论，市中心有栋空楼被改成了某种神秘设施。

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
It all seems pretty
shady, but I guess it's
not really my job to know
about that. I mean, if it
doesn't affect me, why
should I be concerned?
scripts.translation:
[凯蒂娜]
听起来挺可疑的，不过，我想这也不是我该管的事。
只要不影响我，我干吗操心呢？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Surprisingly, we have
a Train Station that everyone
has been calling a victory for
science. I mean, shouldn't we
be more amazed by the Airship?
scripts.translation:
[斯莱克]
真奇怪，我们有了火车站，大家就都说这是科学的胜利。可飞空艇不是更值得惊叹吗？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Now, if you want to know
where the train actually goes,
I wouldn't be able to tell you.
After all, I never rode it. But
still, I guess having our own
Train Station is a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[斯莱克]
你要问火车究竟开往哪里，我可答不上来。毕竟，我从来没坐过。
不过，有自己的火车站，总归是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
...And that's why
I travel around the
globe. My bosses have
a keen eye for the most
exotic goods, so I acquire
them and make deliveries.
scripts.translation:
[鲁南]
...所以我才要满世界跑。老板们专挑最稀奇的货物，我就负责采购，再把货送过去。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
There even was a time
when they had me collect
Jellopy, though that stuff is
pretty common nowadays.
Now that I think about it, why
did they need so much stuff?
scripts.translation:
[鲁南]
有一阵子，他们甚至让我收集杰勒比结晶，虽然这东西现在挺常见的。
现在想想，他们要那么多东西干什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
Now, I hear that the
monsters around here
carry around some ore
that dazzles with a sublimely
beautiful light. Neat, huh?
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
听说这里的魔物身上带着一种矿石，会闪耀出极其美丽的光芒。挺不错吧？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
These ores are a great
material to use in making
flower vases. My friend, who
happens to be a doll maker,
told me that. He makes these dolls using all sorts of materials.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
这些矿石是制作花瓶的好材料。这是我一个做玩偶的朋友告诉我的。
他做玩偶时，什么材料都会用。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
He fashions them out of
Well-Tanned Leather, stuffs
them with Bird Feathers, and
uses Cyfar or Zargon to make
the eyes. He even uses a Jellopy at the bottom to balance the doll.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
他用鞣制皮革做外皮，用羽毛填充，再用赛依伐或刹勒空结晶做眼睛。甚至还会在底部放一颗杰勒比结晶，让玩偶保持平衡。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
I guess that goes to show
that things that seem useless
might actually be handy in some
way. So don't worry about having too much stuff. Sooner or later, it might be useful to someone.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
看来，看似没用的东西，其实也可能派上用场。
所以，东西多也别发愁，迟早会有人用得上。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you just pay me money,
I'll be your slave! There's
nothing I won't do! Anything
is fair game. Hell, I'll get buck naked if you pay me enough.
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
只要给钱，我就当你的奴隶！没什么是我不肯做的，什么都行！
妈的，只要钱给够，让我脱个精光都没问题。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you pay me what I'm
worth, I'll work hard at
any task you set me to.
Sure, mining's rough, but
as long as the zeny's coming
in, I'm happy. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
只要报酬对得起我的付出，你交代什么活，我都会卖力干。
挖矿是辛苦，可只要 Zeny 不断进账，我就开心。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Hey. Why are you
looking at me like
that? There's no idle
chatting allowed at work.
If Canphotii catches
you, you'll be punished...
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
喂，你干吗这样看着我？工作时不许闲聊。
要是被坎福蒂逮着，你会受罚的...

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Oh wait...
You don't work here.
I apologize, that kind
of reaction's an old
habit for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
哦，等等...你不是这里的工人。
抱歉，冒险者，我习惯这样说话了。

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Do you know why a woman
like me has to work in this
factory? I'll tell you why...
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
你知道我一个女人，为什么非得在这工厂里干活吗？我告诉你...

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
My lazy husband, Gesin,
is just lying there on the
ground! So I have to work
in order to support us!
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
我那个懒鬼丈夫格辛，就在那边地上躺着！我只好出来干活，养活我们两个！

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
We can't rest for even
a second if we want to save
enough money to become
wealthy and powerful some
day. Don't you understand?
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
要攒够钱，将来过上有钱有势的日子，就一刻都不能歇着。你明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Well, my husband obviously
doesn't! How can he not know
how the real world works?!
Hey, kick his ass for me if
he doesn't wake up soon!
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
我那丈夫显然不明白！他怎么连世道是怎么回事都不懂？！
喂，要是他还不起来，就替我揍他一顿！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
There was a time
when I dreamed of
being an adventurer,
just like you. But that
was a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
我也曾梦想着像你一样当个冒险者。不过，那已经是很久以前的事了...

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Now, I'm nothing but
a factory manager. Still,
even if my job's not that
great, I'm pretty satisfied.
I'm sure people enjoy the
products I oversee and all...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
如今，我只是个工厂管理员。不过，这工作虽然不怎么了不起，我也挺满足的。
我想，人们一定喜欢我负责生产的那些产品...

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Maybe my life was meant
to be this way, even if it's
not how I planned it. But the
time will come when I up and
leave and travel the world
once I get my chance!
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
也许我这辈子注定如此，虽然跟当初的打算不同。
不过，总有一天，只要机会来了，我就会离开这里，去环游世界！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
I hope the day will
come when I can meet
you out in that big wide
world and greet you as
a fellow adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
希望有一天，能在外面广阔的世界里遇见你，以冒险者同伴的身份向你打招呼。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Arrrgh!
This is killing me!
Why should I be rich?
What's wrong with living
within our means?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
啊啊！真要命！干吗非得有钱不可？量入为出地过日子，有什么不好？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
I've got no problem
with my current way
of life, but the old ball
and chain disagrees.
Why is she so obsessed
with riches and power?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
我觉得现在的日子挺好，可我老婆偏不同意。她怎么就那么痴迷于钱和权势呢？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Well, in any case, I'd
like to help her, but I can't
get up! I'm exhausted and
my body is just overtaxed.
I have no strength at all.
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
不管怎么说，我也想帮她，可我根本起不来！我已经累坏了，身体吃不消，一点力气都没有。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
This is horrible~
I should be resting
instead of worrying
about making money...
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
真受不了~我该好好休息，哪还有心思操心赚钱...

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Good god!
I'm so stressed!
It's been nonstop
since I moved here!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
天哪！压力太大了！从搬来这里开始，就一直没消停过！

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
The work is tough and
already the boss hates
me! I didn't move here
for this! Still, the pay is
decent so I guess I should
endure just a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
活又苦又累，老板还已经看我不顺眼了！我可不是为了过这种日子才搬来的！
不过，工资还不错，还是再忍一阵子吧。

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Here goes...!
Yo-heave-ho!
Yo-heave-ho~!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
开始干活了...！
嘿咻——嘿咻！
嘿咻——嘿咻~！

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
It's great that the
factory is making good
business and drawing
in a lot of profit, but I still
have one major concern.
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
工厂生意兴隆，赚了不少钱，当然是好事。可我还是有件特别担心的事。

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
The amount of pollution
that this place is causing
is horrific! We've got these
machines blowing out toxic
gas all day long! The air
can't be safe for very long...
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
这里造成的污染实在可怕！这些机器整天排放有毒气体，空气恐怕很快就会危害健康了...

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
I mean, the air we're
breathing right now is
pretty foul and things
are only going to get
worse. How can we
solve this problem?
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
我们现在呼吸的空气已经很污浊了，往后只会更糟。这个问题究竟该怎么解决呢？

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Staring at this
bubbling hot liquid
metal gives me a good
feeling inside. It's like
that stuff can melt anything!
scripts.translation:
[冯斯坦]
看着这些滚烫的金属液咕嘟冒泡，我心里就特别舒坦。感觉它们能把什么都熔掉！

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Imagine covering an
entire street of people
with that stuff! Bwahah--
Oh, I'm sorry if I'm talking
crazy talk! I'm just kidding~
scripts.translation:
[冯斯坦]
想象一下，把这东西浇在整条街的人身上！哇哈哈——
哦，抱歉，我是不是说疯话了？开个玩笑而已~

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Machines are sooo
convenient. Just look
at this contraption easily
do tasks that'd be tough
for me to finish alone.
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
机器真是方便啊。你看，这个装置轻轻松松就能干完那些我一个人很难完成的活。

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Now this is what
I call technology!
Sure, it takes effort and
money to make one of
these, but what do I care?
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
这才叫技术！造这么一台机器，当然要费钱费力，可那关我什么事？

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
I've got no problems,
so long as this freaking
thing keeps working the
way I want it to!
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
只要这玩意儿能按我的要求一直运转，我就没什么好抱怨的！

scripts.text:
[Khashurantze]
I'm sorry, but you need
special authority in order
to enter this place. I'll have
to ask you to leave right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡舒兰策]
很抱歉，进入此地需要特殊权限。请您立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
I'm in charge of this
blast furnace which
contains all of this
boiling magma.
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
我负责管理这座高炉，里面装满了沸腾的岩浆。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Even though it doesn't
require actual labor, this
job is pretty tiring. I've got
to pay careful attention all
the time. It's pretty stressful.
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
虽然不用干体力活，但这份工作还是很累。得时刻集中注意力，压力不小。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Still, I'm proud of my job
since I have the responsibility
of ensuring employee safety.
Anyway, don't get too close
to the furnace. It won't do if
you get burned on accident!
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
不过，能负责保障员工的安全，我为这份工作感到自豪。
总之，别离高炉太近，万一不小心烧伤了可就不好了！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Hustle, hustle!
Pick up the pace!
Anyone working too
slowly will be punished!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
快点，快点！动作麻利点！谁干活太慢，谁就要受罚！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Can't you understand
that?! Now go to your
station and get back to
work! Wait, are you even
an employee? If not, then
stop wandering around!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
听不明白吗？！现在就回岗位上干活！
等等，你是这里的员工吗？不是就别在这儿乱晃！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
You're not supposed
to be able to get in here!
I can't believe they let you
in! This requires extreme
disciplinary action!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
你不该进得来这里！真不敢相信他们竟然放你进来了！必须严加处分！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
This factory has a lot
of things that need fixing,
pronto! I'm amazed that
the place is still operating!
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
这工厂好多地方都急着要修！它竟然还能运转，真叫人吃惊！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
Lucky for us, I hear that
some altruistic adventurers
have been donating materials
to help keep this factory from
falling apart... Or worse.
But that's just a rumor.
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
幸好，听说有些热心的冒险者一直在捐材料，帮忙防止这工厂垮掉...或发生更糟的事。
不过，这也只是传闻。

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
Even if it is true,
there's nothing no one
here can do. Nobody has
the courage to challenge
the system, you know?
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
^666666*唉*^000000
就算是真的，我们这里的人也无能为力。没人敢挑战这套制度，你懂吧？

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
I...
I better get
back to work
before I get
in trouble...
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
我...我还是赶紧回去干活吧，免得惹上麻烦...
